Name: Love in the Air - Rival Heart Romances
Author: Durinthal
Description:
[size=6]Love in the Air[/size]

Dissatisfied with the Flower Dance couples? Ever wonder what a relationship between two of the other bachelors/bachelorettes would look like? This mod explores new possibilities where villagers date each other with unique stories for each pairing.

[size=4]Note: Villagers in enabled pairings will no longer be available for the player to date and marry after a certain point in their story.[/size]

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]

This mod is compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]. Visuals from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]Diverse Stardew Valley[/url] should work but the dialogue hasn't yet been updated to respect the nonbinary Abigail option.

This mod is [b]not[/b] compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10021]Free Love[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20599]PolyamorySweet[/url] if you want to marry any of the villagers affected by this mod.

[size=5]Abigail and Leah[/size]

[spoiler]
[b]One Heart Event[/b]
[list]
[*]You must have at least 1 heart with both Abigail and Leah
[*]Enter the forest when Abigail is there and it's not winter (usually Sundays)
[/list][b]Three Heart Event[/b]
[list]
[*]You must have at least 3 hearts with both Abigail and Leah
[*]You must have seen the joint one heart event
[*]Enter Pierre's shop when Leah is there (usually Mondays)
[/list][b]Five Heart Event[/b]
[list]
[*]You must have at least 5 hearts with both Abigail and Leah
[*]You must have seen the joint three heart event
[*]Enter Leah's house when Leah is there
[/list][b]Seven Heart Event[/b]
[list]
[*]You must have at least 7 hearts with both Abigail and Leah
[*]You must have seen the joint five heart event
[*]Enter the forest after 9pm on a day with sunny weather
[/list][b]Abigail's Eight Heart Event[/b]
[list]
[*]You must have 8 hearts with Abigail
[*]You must have seen the joint seven heart event
[*]You must not be dating Abigail or Leah
[*]Replaces Abigail's vanilla eight heart event, same preconditions apply
[/list][b]Leah's Eight Heart Event[/b]
[list]
[*]You must have 8 hearts with Leah
[*]You must have seen the joint three heart event
[*]Replaces Leah's vanilla eight heart event, same preconditions apply
[/list][b]Final Heart Event[/b]
[list]
[*]You must have at least 8 hearts with both Abigail and Leah
[*]You must have seen Abigail's and Leah's updated eight heart events
[*]You must not be dating Abigail or Leah
[*]Enter the forest between 11am and 4pm on a sunny day when it's not winter
[/list]
[b]Note:[/b] Abigail and Leah's 10 heart events will no longer be available after seeing the final heart event.
[/spoiler]

[size=5]Upcoming[/size]

While there's currently only one couple, more are planned for the future so this mod wasn't named specifically for them. But first comes full i18n support and DSV compatibility, since this was somewhat rushed to be released as part of the current Modfest[size=3].

[/size][size=5]Credits / Acknowledgements[/size][size=3]
[/size]
